author: TexLite contributors
description: Full encoder-decoder Transformer redrawn after Figure 1 of Vaswani et al., NeurIPS 2017: embeddings and positional encodings, the repeated encoder and decoder stacks with residual connections, the encoder memory feeding the decoder's middle attention, and the Linear and Softmax output head.

invariants: positions are in layout units traced from the original figure; move boxes and wires together so that wires still meet their boxes
the two arrows from the encoder memory enter the left and middle of the decoder's middle attention; the right arrow comes from the decoder's own previous layer
preserve the enc-*, dec-*, linear, softmax and probs node names
keep the source note at the top of the file

operations.summary: edit the label macros at the top
change one \definecolor value; every layer of that kind follows
change the fill of one layer node to mark the part a paper modifies
delete the decoder wiring, the decoder layers, the decoder stack and its wave and plus, and end the encoder output at a caption
edit \gridunit; the type size stays fixed, so reduce the font key if boxes get tight

parameters.meaning: size of one layout unit; scales the geometry while the type size stays fixed
parameters.name: \gridunit

parameters.meaning: weight of every box and arrow
parameters.name: \linew
